description: Console, decisions, permissions and HUD shots (client.console / decisions / permissions / hud). Run against the showcase busy state: node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs tools/scenes/console.json --port <devPort> --foreman <foremanPort> --prefix console/. The permission shot shows the oldest open permission prompt, or a marked preview of a sample one when none is open (the showcase has none).

shots.name: console_autocomplete
shots.title: Console: live feed, @ju autocomplete with ghost text and the 'what Enter does' hint

shots.name: console_decision_question
shots.title: Decision screen: the queue head (a question in the showcase), options on keys 1-9, free-text answer

shots.name: console_decision_merge
shots.title: Decision screen on the merge decision: branch, stats, file list, Review diff / Merge / Request changes / Reject

shots.name: console_permission
shots.title: Permission prompt: tool + command, risk chip and reason, cwd, what 'Always allow' covers, Allow once / Always allow / Deny

shots.name: console_podium
shots.title: Decision Podium: waiting count + first question in a bubble over the lit podium

shots.name: console_terminal
shots.title: Console terminal screen: waiting count + key, the newest feed item (face, name, two lines), the prompt

shots.name: console_hud
shots.title: HUD: goal bar with task counts, decisions badge, a 'needs you' toast, connection pill
